profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation software. The software covers modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil drawing, and VFX work, and it is used in short films, advertisements, TV series, and feature films. Blender is built on a flexible Python-controlled interface and supports a community ecosystem of add-ons, tutorial makers, and global marketplaces. The foundation describes Blender as a member of ASWF, the Khronos Group, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, and notes hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks a category of Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins for 3D creation that run with local processing and vary in model provenance depending on the individual plugin. Blender 5.2 LTS, referenced on the site, introduces features such as a Cycles Texture Cache for more memory-efficient rendering of scenes with many image textures, new Grease Pencil textured brushes, and an Online Essentials Asset Library with customizable procedural materials. The foundation also announced OVERGROWN as Blender Studio's latest feature film project.

The held facts record no litigation and no MCP server presence. The foundation's profile is verified as of August 22, 2026, and it is classified as a non-profit open-source foundation.
